chunk_map.heading: Generic AI is everyone's; your material is yours
Sharpen the insights, never the sources
A file the team writes once steers every answer
New interviews make the insight pages sharper, not longer

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: chunk 2 "Sharpen the insights": "The team's folder has three layers" is the closest call: the folder is introduced by that sentence itself and its layers are enumerated at once; chunk 3 "A file the team writes once": "the agent reads each time" resolves to "the agent" named in chunk 1 ("Put that in front of the agent"); chunk 4 "insight pages" resolves to chunk 2's bolded "Insight pages:" lead. No forward pointers, no unresolved pronouns.
No chunk points at another file or lecture by position; grep "the opening|earlier|previous|last slide" over the four slide files returned no hits (exit 1).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no "the X you did/saw/caught" references; "the calls you made" (chunk 1) is a general description of what a team holds, not a beat

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.

rules_evaluated.evidence: Smallest chunk, 4 "New interviews make the insight pages sharper, not longer" (79 words), carries a full mechanism (read pages, read new material, rewrite; cut claims) plus an ask ("Read the cuts too"); none is a wait-state slide.

chunk 2 header "Sharpen the insights, never the sources" vs body "Let the agent rewrite a source and you lose the evidence": body supports both halves. chunk 4 header "sharper, not longer" vs "does not add a new section ... rewrites": matches. Closest: chunk 1 header "Generic AI is everyone's" vs body "much the same answer you would": consistent.

grep -nE "^\s*Not |\. Not " over the four slide files returned no hits (exit 1). Closest: chunk 3 "The product owner knows the outcome, the designer the customer's own words, the team lead what the agents may touch": three parallel clauses but each leg carries distinct concrete content, not anaphora or an empty verb triplet. No self-grading superlatives, no number+retraction, no abstraction-noun stacks.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: grep -niE "surface|firing|compendium|forcing|beat" over the four slide files: no hits in body (matches only in maintainer STATUS blocks, outside the body). Closest: "insight pages" / "rules file" are the team-facing names, ordinary product-team vocabulary.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: chunk 2 carries three bolds ("**Sources:**", "**Insight pages:**", "**The rules file:**"): each is a 2-3 word handle on a named layer (checklist-item names), never a whole lead sentence; other three chunks carry no bold. Closest to violating, but within the handle allowance.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Presence precedes content — verify against the composed deck, not long-read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Body is four include-links `[Title](slides/<id>.md)`; the expanded view (expand-md) inlined all four as `##` chunks, and check-slide-size --report listed 4 slides for this file, so all are in the composed deck.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Numbering — position is computed, content ordinals are linted.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-numbering.js --file curriculum/lectures/apt101-your-material-is-the-moat.md → "OK — 1 files, Phase/Step numbering consistent." exit 0; no hand-numbered headers.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Page geometry dies at the cut; reading order survives.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-deixis.js --file ... --report → exit 0, no matches; grep for above|below over the slide files returned no hits.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: In-deck links work now; whether they EARN their place is open.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no in-body links beyond the structural includes; rule states there is no gate here

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Slide size — 210 words / 6 bullets, and the cap is machine-checked.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-size.js --file curriculum/lectures/apt101-your-material-is-the-moat.md --report → "oversized: 0", largest 106 words / 0 bullets (limits 210 / 6), exit 0.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Heading grammar is the mood switch, and it is load-bearing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: All four lecture headings are claims ("Generic AI is everyone's; your material is yours", "Sharpen the insights, never the sources", "A file the team writes once steers every answer", "New interviews make the insight pages sharper, not longer"); no label headings in a lecture.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A bullet earns its slot or dies — three classes that read as rigour and carry nothing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Closest: chunk 3 last sentence "A file written by all three of you steers better than one written by whoever got there first" partly echoes the header but adds a new claim (co-authorship) and the three-seat division before it; chunk 2 last paragraph adds traceability as the reason for the header, not a restatement; chunk 4 "Read the cuts too" is a move. No doctrine restatement, design commentary or koan kicker.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A retitled slide re-earns its bullets against the new header.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no header rename over inherited bullets; slides were composed fresh from the squint (maintainer STATUS 2026-10-07)

notes: Brief built normally (17 rules, prefill parked none). Slide files live in curriculum/slides/, resolved via expand-md.
